column1: # Which reading to teach for words that CC-CEDICT gives several readings for.
# The HSK dataset lists every dictionary reading, so we pick the everyday one(s).
# Each reading must still exist in CC-CEDICT; its meaning always comes from that
# same CC-CEDICT entry, so pinyin and meaning can never be mismatched.
# Two readings on one line = two separate entries (e.g. 还 hái "still", huán "to return").
